Hello! I had the pleasure of observing your class, and I want to share some highlights and opportunities for growth with you today. 

One major strength I noticed was your excellent use of concrete models and real-world examples. For instance, when you used a cake to explain fractions, it really helped the students connect with the concept of parts of a whole. This approach got the students engaged and even encouraged them to share personal connections, like relating it to a birthday celebration.

Now, for an opportunity to enhance your teaching further: let's talk about feedback. While you often praised students and reinforced vocabulary, there’s a chance to build on their responses with more specific guidance. For example, when a student correctly identifies the numerator, you might say, “Great, now can you tell me why that’s the numerator?” This kind of follow-up can deepen their understanding and reasoning skills.

Keep up the great work, and remember, small changes can make a big impact on your students' learning journey. I look forward to seeing how these strategies unfold in your future lessons!
